method: Ten explicit symbol/file pairs mentioned in the previous discussion; match literal symbol in a node label, then check direct mapped ranges. Full definition requires every line from fn declaration through its matching closing brace. Comments/strings are excluded from brace parsing. Does not measure downstream callees or semantic precision.
